name: Conmat to network
summary: Utility that converts a connectivity matrix (conmat: CSV matrices, index and labels) into a compressed JSON Graph Format network for the brainlife network pipeline.
description: Reads each matrix listed in the conmat index.json, attaches the node labels from label.json and the matrix properties, and writes all of them as networks in a JGF file (network.json.gz) with igraph. Use it to feed connectomes into network-analysis Apps that take the network datatype.

inputs.description: Connectivity matrix  file to be converted to a network

outputs.description: Network file converted from a conmat (connectivity matrix) datatype. All metadata is preserved.
